The '''twenty-second assault fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Early in the [[Third Galactic War]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron]] acted as the fleet's overseer.<ref name="JUS" />
